purpose: Per-leaf implementation inventory for every authored PDP-0 capability intent; classifications cite exact task/source links and never fabricate success.

policy.implemented: requires a VERIFIED register task bound to the capability family
policy.delegated: reserved for wholly externally executed intents; Media leaves consuming platform dependencies use delegatedDependencies
policy.unknownFailsAudit: any leaf without a classification, or any family missing from the reviewed map, fails --check
policy.localEvidence: optional per-leaf test-backed DEV_ONLY evidence; never changes classification; unknown leaves, missing tests or partial entries without gaps fail generation

externalOwnedDependencies.document-intelligence-v1-public-client: Ghatana Document Intelligence owns generic OCR execution and the public OCR gateway (MDI-001/PDP0-003-D4); Media consumes the v1 public client for scene/time/ROI-authorized results only.
externalOwnedDependencies.shared-identity-and-authorization: Ghatana Shared owns reusable identity/authorization primitives; Media capabilities still own their rights checks and effect admission.
externalOwnedDependencies.tools-action-plane: Ghatana Tools owns delegated agent execution surfaces that call Media APIs; Media owns invocation fencing and per-replay authorization.
externalOwnedDependencies.data-cloud-optional-downstream: Ghatana Data Cloud may index/project derived Media metadata as an optional downstream consumer (media.dev.optional-data-cloud-adapter); it is never a Media processing path or ledger.

gaps: Shared workspace membership is synthetic owner scope only
reviewer is the DEV_ONLY synthetic owner, not current assigned reviewer authority; establishesApproval stays false
no explicit review purpose/scope selection (quality, rights, provenance, approval) or expiry disposition
current access policy is owner-only DEV_ONLY scope
current-rights revocation is not re-checked after attachment
qualified scanner release is not admitted
only still-image storyboard GIF derivation; no explicit transformation-profile identity/version/configuration digest
no rights decision is bound to the derivation
no queued-job observation; derivation runs synchronously
policy decision is DEV_ONLY owner scope; registration does not attach the output to the project or deliver it
storyboard order is the revision's scene/track/story-time order; there is no separate storyboard/shot-plan edition or scene arrangement operation
project-hosted path arranges VIDEO still clips and one AUDIO WAV clip only; captions are renderer-only (no timeline caption-text source)
overlay tracks, gaps/overlaps, multiple audio clips and transitions are typed UNSUPPORTED

operations: POST /dev/v1/projects/{projectId}/renders with format mp4 (manifest digest in lineage)
gaps: the manifest is recorded by digest in render lineage, not stored as its own reviewable draft
